name: lacuna.list_tools
description: Search the Lacuna domain-tool catalogue, including descriptions, input schemas and permission levels. Use this before guessing a tool name.

name: lacuna.list_courses
description: List every course in the local Lacuna database, ordered by creation time.

name: lacuna.find_course
description: Resolve a Course (sometimes called a deck) by id, exact name or partial name. Returns compact choices rather than full scheduling records.

query.description: Course id, exact name or partial name.

name: lacuna.get_course
description: Fetch a single course by id.

courseId.description: The id of the course to query.

name: lacuna.list_course_assessments
description: List a course's assessments with full persisted semantics and resolved scope.

courseId.description: The id of the course to query.

name: lacuna.get_course_assessment
description: Fetch one assessment with its exact resolved lessons, cards and validation state.

assessmentId.description: The id of the assessment to fetch.

name: lacuna.list_lessons
description: List a course's lessons, ordered by their position on the course path.

courseId.description: The id of the course to query.

name: lacuna.list_cards
description: List cards belonging to a course, or scoped to a single lesson within it.

courseId.description: The id of the course to query.

lessonId.description: If given, list only the cards taught in this lesson (primary plus linked cards). Otherwise list every card belonging to the course.

name: lacuna.search_cards
description: Resolve one Course by name or id, then return compact, cursor-paginated Card content without FSRS state or review history.

course.description: Course id, exact name or unambiguous partial name.

query.description: Optional text matched against Card content, tags and Lesson name.

includePayload.description: Include structured numeric or working payloads. Off by default.

name: lacuna.get_card
description: Fetch a single card by id.

cardId.description: The id of the card to fetch.

name: lacuna.list_due_cards
description: List available scheduled reviews due now for a course, ranked by its objective. Excludes new and future cards.

courseId.description: The id of the course to query.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Omit for no limit.

name: lacuna.get_weak_cards
description: A course's weakest available cards: leeches first, then every other card ascending by objective score, so the lowest-scoring, least-secured cards surface first.

courseId.description: The id of the course to query.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Omit for no limit.

name: lacuna.get_course_stats
description: Bundled stats for a course: nearest-exam/mastery/due-count header stats plus the study time forecast, both scoped to the course.

courseId.description: The id of the course to query.

name: lacuna.list_sequences
description: List a course's sequences, ordered by creation time.

courseId.description: The id of the course to query.

name: lacuna.get_sequence
description: Fetch a single sequence by id.

sequenceId.description: The id of the sequence to fetch.

name: lacuna.list_occlusions
description: List a course's image occlusions, ordered by creation time.

courseId.description: The id of the course whose occlusions to list.

name: lacuna.get_occlusion
description: Fetch a single image occlusion by id, including every region and its fractional coordinates.

occlusionId.description: The id of the occlusion to fetch.

name: lacuna.list_notes
description: List a lesson's notes, ordered by their position within the lesson.

lessonId.description: The id of the lesson whose notes to list.

name: lacuna.diagnostics_summary
description: Record counts for a diagnostic summary: whole-database counts, or counts scoped to a single course when courseId is given.

courseId.description: If given, scope the record counts to this course. Otherwise return whole-database counts.

name: lacuna.create_course
description: Create a new course with sensible scheduling defaults (exam date, FSRS parameters, unlock mode).

name: lacuna.update_course
description: Update a course's name, description, and/or primary exam date.

courseId.description: The id of the course.

examDate.description: New primary exam date/time, as an epoch millisecond value in UTC.

name: lacuna.create_lesson
description: Create a new lesson at the end of a course's path.

courseId.description: The id of the course.

name: lacuna.update_lesson
description: Update a lesson's name and/or description.

name: lacuna.create_note
description: Create a new Markdown note at the end of a lesson's notes.

content.description: Rich Markdown source. Defaults to empty.

name: lacuna.update_note
description: Update a note's name and/or Markdown content.

noteId.description: The id of the note to update.

name: lacuna.create_card
description: Create a new card, either unassigned in a course's question bank or assigned to a lesson when lessonId is given.

courseId.description: The id of the course.

lessonId.description: If given, create the card in this lesson. Otherwise create it unassigned, in the course question bank.

front.description: Markdown source for the question/prompt side.

back.description: Markdown source for the answer side. Unused (empty) for cloze cards.

name: lacuna.update_card
description: Update a card's content: front, back, tags, and/or flagged state. Never touches FSRS scheduling fields (state, stability, difficulty, due) — those are the study engine's exclusive write path. Refuses cards generated by a sequence or an occlusion; edit those via their owning sequence (lacuna.update_sequence) or occlusion.

cardId.description: The id of the card to update.

front.description: New Markdown source for the question/prompt side.

back.description: New Markdown source for the answer side.

flagged.description: New flagged state, for quick filtering/follow-up.

name: lacuna.link_card_to_lesson
description: Display-link an existing card into an additional lesson, alongside its primary lesson. Idempotent: linking an already-linked card is a no-op that returns the existing link.

cardId.description: The id of the card to link.

name: lacuna.create_sequence
description: Create a new overlapping-cloze sequence and, in the same transaction, every card it generates.

courseId.description: The id of the course.

lessonId.description: If given, scope the sequence (and its generated cards) to this lesson. Otherwise the course question bank.

id.description: Stable id for this item — anchors the card(s) generated from it across edits.

value.description: Markdown source for the recallable unit.

chunkIndex.description: Membership of a named chunk (see chunkLabels).

speaker.description: `lines` mode only: who speaks this line.

items.description: Ordered recallable units the sequence generates cards from.

cueWindow.description: How many preceding items are shown as cue. Defaults to 2.

mode.description: `list` (default): every item generates a positional recall card. `lines`: script mode, see mySpeaker.

mySpeaker.description: `lines` mode only: the speaker whose lines are the recall target.

recitationChunkSize.description: Lines mode only: lines per chunk in cumulative recitation. Omit to chunk by stanza, or by 4 lines.

name: lacuna.update_sequence
description: Update a sequence's name, items, and/or cue window, regenerating its cards to match. Card content is diffed and updated in place where possible, so existing FSRS memory state survives content-only regeneration.

sequenceId.description: The id of the sequence to update.

items.description: Replacement ordered list of recallable units.

id.description: Stable id for this item — anchors the card(s) generated from it across edits.

value.description: Markdown source for the recallable unit.

chunkIndex.description: Membership of a named chunk (see chunkLabels).

speaker.description: `lines` mode only: who speaks this line.

recitationChunkSize.description: Lines mode only: lines per chunk in cumulative recitation. Omit to chunk by stanza, or by 4 lines.

name: lacuna.create_occlusion
description: Create an image occlusion over an existing diagram and, in the same transaction, one card per region.

courseId.description: The id of the course.

lessonId.description: If given, scope the occlusion (and its generated cards) to this lesson. Otherwise the course question bank.

name.description: The occlusion name, used in each generated card's text fallback.

assetHash.description: Hash of a diagram already stored in this install (see lacuna.get_occlusion).

id.description: Stable id for this region — anchors the card generated from it across edits.

role.description: `label`: masks text printed on the diagram, revealed by uncovering it. `feature`: points at part of the drawing and is answered by its paired label region.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of image width, 0..1.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of image height, 0..1.

w.description: Width as a fraction of image width, 0..1.

h.description: Height as a fraction of image height, 0..1.

answerText.description: Required for typed mode and for an unpaired feature region.

pairedRegionId.description: `feature` regions only: the label region that answers this one.

backNote.description: Optional extra shown below the image on the back.

regions.description: The regions to generate one card each from. Every label region is masked on every front.

name: lacuna.update_occlusion
description: Update an occlusion's name, diagram and/or regions, regenerating its cards to match. Card content is diffed and updated in place where possible, so existing FSRS memory state survives content-only regeneration (moving or resizing a region, re-pairing, role changes).

occlusionId.description: The id of the occlusion to update.

assetHash.description: Replacement diagram. Regenerates every card in the occlusion.

id.description: Stable id for this region — anchors the card generated from it across edits.

role.description: `label`: masks text printed on the diagram, revealed by uncovering it. `feature`: points at part of the drawing and is answered by its paired label region.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of image width, 0..1.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of image height, 0..1.

w.description: Width as a fraction of image width, 0..1.

h.description: Height as a fraction of image height, 0..1.

answerText.description: Required for typed mode and for an unpaired feature region.

pairedRegionId.description: `feature` regions only: the label region that answers this one.

backNote.description: Optional extra shown below the image on the back.

name: lacuna.create_course_assessment
description: Create a checkpoint assessment with explicit path placement, coverage and card exclusions.

courseId.description: The id of the course.

examDate.description: The date/time as an epoch millisecond value, in UTC.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used to display the date.

afterLessonId.description: Path anchor; null places it before lesson one.

examDate.description: The date/time as an epoch millisecond value, in UTC.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used to display the date.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used to display the date.

courseId.description: The id of the course.

examDate.description: The date/time as an epoch millisecond value, in UTC.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used to display the date.

afterLessonId.description: Path anchor; null places it before lesson one.

name: lacuna.update_course_assessment
description: Update an assessment without changing its stable identity or course.

assessmentId.description: The id of the assessment to update.

examDate.description: New date/time as an epoch millisecond value, in UTC.

needsAuthorConfirmation.description: Whether an author must review references.

name: lacuna.list_concepts
description: List a Course's Concepts, ordered by name.

courseId.description: The id of the Course.

name: lacuna.create_concept
description: Create a Concept that Cards and Questions may reference.

courseId.description: The id of the Course.

name: lacuna.update_concept
description: Update a Concept's display name. Migration provenance requires independent review.

name: lacuna.delete_concept
description: Delete an unreferenced Concept. Refuses Concepts still used by a Card or Question.

name: lacuna.list_questions
description: List fixed Questions and generated families separately from Cards.

courseId.description: The id of the Course.

name: lacuna.get_question
description: Fetch one Question definition and its target/prerequisite Concept set.

questionId.description: The id of a Question definition.

name: lacuna.create_fixed_question
description: Create a fixed application Question with one primary target, optional prerequisites and mandatory worked feedback.

courseId.description: The id of the Course.

name: lacuna.update_fixed_question
description: Update fixed Question authoring. Semantic changes start a new Question scheduling epoch.

questionId.description: The id of a Question definition.

name: lacuna.create_generated_question
description: Create one scheduled generated Question family from an audited built-in generator configuration.

courseId.description: The id of the Course.

name: lacuna.update_generated_question
description: Update a generated family. Generator, configuration or Concept changes start a new scheduling epoch.

questionId.description: The id of a Question definition.

name: lacuna.delete_question
description: Delete a Question definition and its Concept links while retaining immutable attempt evidence.

questionId.description: The id of a Question definition.

name: lacuna.list_question_generators
description: List versioned built-in Question generators and their typed configuration fields.

name: lacuna.audit_question_generator
description: Validate a built-in generator configuration and return its deterministic audited corpus before authoring.

name: lacuna.delete_card
description: Permanently delete one or more cards. Refuses cards generated by a sequence — delete or edit those via lacuna.update_sequence/lacuna.delete_sequence instead.

name: lacuna.delete_lesson
description: Delete a lesson: its notes and lesson-card links are removed, but cards whose primary lesson was this one become unassigned (kept in the course question bank) rather than deleted.

lessonId.description: The id of the lesson to delete.

name: lacuna.delete_course
description: Permanently delete a course and everything in it: lessons, notes, cards, sequences and exam dates.

courseId.description: The id of the course to delete.

name: lacuna.delete_sequence
description: Permanently delete a sequence and every card it generated.

sequenceId.description: The id of the sequence to delete.

name: lacuna.delete_occlusion
description: Permanently delete an image occlusion and every card it generated.

occlusionId.description: The id of the occlusion to delete.

name: lacuna.delete_course_assessment
description: Delete a checkpoint assessment. The sole final assessment cannot be deleted.

assessmentId.description: The id of the checkpoint assessment to delete.

name: lacuna.suspend_cards
description: Suspend or un-suspend one or more cards, withholding/restoring them from study and progress.

suspended.description: true to suspend (withhold from study), false to un-suspend.

name: lacuna.set_cards_flag
description: Set or clear one or more cards' flag, a marker for quick filtering and follow-up.

flagged.description: true to flag, false to clear the flag.

name: lacuna.reschedule_cards
description: Bulk-reschedule cards: either reset them to New (clearing stability, difficulty, due, etc.) or set a custom due date. Never writes raw FSRS fields directly — bounded to these two options.

reset.description: Reset selected cards to the New state, clearing all scheduling data.

due.description: Set a specific due date, as an epoch millisecond value. Takes precedence over reset.

name: lacuna.diff_import_preview
description: Preview how a batch of proposed cards compares to a course's existing cards, without writing anything: which are new (toCreate), which already exist verbatim (toSkip), and which share a question but have different content (toUpdate, apply manually via lacuna.update_card).

courseId.description: The id of the course to diff against.

front.description: Markdown source for the question/prompt side.

back.description: Markdown source for the answer side.

lessonId.description: If given, the card belongs to this lesson; otherwise the course question bank.

items.description: Proposed cards to compare against existing content.

name: lacuna.import_cards
description: Import a batch of proposed cards into a course: creates cards that are new, skips ones that already exist verbatim, and reports (without applying) any that share a question but have different content. Safe to re-run with the same payload — the second call creates nothing new.

courseId.description: The id of the course to diff against.

front.description: Markdown source for the question/prompt side.

back.description: Markdown source for the answer side.

lessonId.description: If given, the card belongs to this lesson; otherwise the course question bank.

items.description: Proposed cards to compare against existing content.

name: lacuna.diff_lineage_update
description: Preview how a teacher's re-published share code compares to a course already tracking that lineage, without writing anything: creates/updates/removals and student-edit conflicts, exactly the classification the in-app review panel would show.

courseId.description: The id of the locally-tracked course to diff against.

shareCode.description: The teacher's re-published share code to preview against this course.

name: lacuna.apply_lineage_update
description: Apply a teacher's re-published share code to a course already tracking that lineage, exactly as the in-app review flow would: creates apply immediately, updates/removals apply or queue per the course's auto-accept setting, and student-edit conflicts always queue. Optionally pass `decisions` to pre-resolve specific queued items in the same call.

courseId.description: The id of the locally-tracked course to update.

shareCode.description: The teacher's re-published share code to merge in.

decisions.description: Pre-resolve specific queued items, mirroring the review panel. Anything left unresolved stays queued.

name: lacuna.search_memories
description: Search relevant learner-correctable memories in one explicit global or Course scope. Results exclude expired session memories and are ordered by most recent evidence.

name: lacuna.create_memory
description: Create bounded, learner-correctable teaching context from stated, inferred or observed evidence. Global memories cannot reference Course content.

name: lacuna.update_memory
description: Correct evidence, status or wording for one learner memory without moving its immutable scope.

name: lacuna.delete_memory
description: Delete one learner memory. Lacuna retains an exhaustive local Undo snapshot.
